snp4.14:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Tuṭaṭakasutta. "Pucchāmi taṃ Adiccabandhaṃ vivekaṃ santipadañ ca mahesiṃ: kathaṃ disvā nibbāti bhikkhu anupādiyāno lokasmiṃ kiñci". || ||
snp4.14:2.1: "Mūlaṃ papañcasaṃkhāyā ti Bhagavā ‘mantā asmī' ti sabbam uparundhe, yā kāci taṇhā ajjhattaṃ, tāsaṃ vinayā sadā sato sikkhe. || ||
snp4.14:3.1: Yaṃ kiñci dhammam abhijaññā ajjhattam atha vā pi bahiddhā, na tena thāmaṃ kubbetha, na hi sā nibbuti sataṃ vuttā: || ||
snp4.14:4.1: seyyo na tena maññeyya nīceyyo atha vā pi sarikkho, -- puṭṭho anekarūpehi nātumānaṃ vikappayan tiṭṭhe. || ||
snp4.14:5.1: Ajjhattam eva upasame, nāññato bhikkhu santim eseyya: ajjhattaṃ upasantassa n' atthi attā, kuto nirattaṃ vā. || ||
snp4.14:6.1: Majjhe yathā samuddassa ūmi no jāyatī, ṭhito hoti, evaṃ ṭhito onej' assa: ussadaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci". || ||
snp4.14:7.1: "Akittayi vivaṭacakkhu sakkhi dhammaṃ parissayavinayaṃ, paṭipadaṃ vadehi, bhaddan te, pātimokkhaṃ atha vā pi samādhiṃ". || ||
snp4.14:8.1: "Cakkhūhi n' eva lol' assa, gāmakathāya āvaraye sotaṃ, rase ca nānugijjheyya, na ca mamāyetha kiñci lokasmiṃ. || ||
snp4.14:9.1: Phassena yadā phuṭṭh' assa, paridevaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci, bhavañ ca nābhijappeyya bheravesu ca na sampavedheyya. || ||
snp4.14:10.1: Annānam atho pānānaṃ khādaniyānaṃ atho pi vatthānaṃ laddhā na sannidhiṃ kayirā, na ca parittase tāni alabhamāno. || ||
snp4.14:11.1: Jhāyī na pādalol' assa, virame kukkuccaṃ, na-ppamajjeyya, atha āsanesu sayanesu appasaddesu bhikkhu vihareyya. || ||
snp4.14:12.1: Niddaṃ na bahulīkareyya, jāgariyaṃ bhajeyya ātāpī, tandiṃ māyaṃ hassaṃ khiḍḍaṃ methunaṃ vippajahe savibhūsaṃ. || ||
snp4.14:13.1: Āthabbaṇaṃ supinaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ no vidahe atho pi nakkhattaṃ, virutañ ca gabbhakaraṇaṃ tikicchaṃ māmako na seveyya. || ||
snp4.14:14.1: Nindāya na-ppavedheyya, na uṇṇameyya pasaṃsito bhikkhu, lobhaṃ saha macchariyena kodhaṃ pesuṇiyañ ca panudeyya. || ||
snp4.14:15.1: Kayavikkaye na tiṭṭheyya, upavādaṃ bhikkhu na kareyya kuhiñci, gāme ca nābhisajjeyya, lābhakamyā janaṃ na lāpayeyya. || ||
snp4.14:16.1: Na ca katthitā siyā bhikkhu, na ca vācaṃ payutaṃ bhāseyya, pāgabbhiyaṃ na sikkheyya, kathaṃ viggākikaṃ na kathayeyya. || ||
snp4.14:17.1: Mosavajje na niyyetha, sampajāno saṭhāni na kayirā,| atha jīvitena paññāya sīlavatena nāññam atimaññe. || ||
snp4.14:18.1: Sutvā rusito bahuṃ vācaṃ samaṇānaṃ puthuvacanānaṃ pharusena ne na paṭivajjā, na hi santo paṭisenikaronti. || ||
snp4.14:19.1: Etañ ca dhammam aññāya vicinaṃ bhikkhu sadā sato sikkhe, ‘santī' ti nibbutiṃ ñatvā sāsane Gotamassa na-ppamajjeyya. || ||
snp4.14:20.1: Abhibhū hi so anabhibhūto sakkhi dhammaṃ anītiham adassī tasmā hi tassa Bhagavato sāsane appamatto sadā namassam anusikkhe" ti Bhagavā ti || || TUVAṬAKASUTTAṂ
